messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: Orbiter (VPC) — elevated 5xx from tenant orbiter-prod in dedicated pool dp-orbiter. Threshold: >15% 3m. Pager: oncall-sre.

Alex R: oncall here, looking. can someone paste the top errors?

Emily S: seeing spikes in redis timeouts + model-serve 502s. looks like a hot-node in dp-orbiter is flapping.

oncall-opsbot: Incident created: INC-3600123456 — Orbiter VPC dedicated pool isolation. Priority: P1.

Alex R: ok i'm going to mark node-07 out of service and drain. doing cordon + drain on k8s.

Emily S: copying commands:
```
kubectl cordon node-07.dp-orbiter
kubectl drain node-07.dp-orbiter --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```

Raj P: I'll put a temporary routing rule at the LB to avoid node-07 ip. patching now.

Raj P: applied ip rule: `ip route replace 10.12.7.0/24 via 10.12.100.1` on lb-orbiter-01.

Emily S: thanks. looking at logs — 502s are associated with kernel OOM on node-07, but memory pressure looks unusual, maybe runaway cache. KV cache size for the model was high.

Alex R: created mitigation: reduced model kv_cache_max in runtime config for dp-orbiter canary to 1GB, applied via rollout.

Alex R: patch snippet:
```
- name: kv_cache_max
  value: "1g"
```

Priya K: Priya (CSM) here — i've pinged Orbiter account team and told them we have isolated the node and are mitigating. they reported increased latencies but not data loss. customer is on a support call at 16:30 PT.

Sam T: finance/accounting note — Orbiter is enterprise, contract includes dedicated SLAs. they will expect a post-incident comm + potential credit. tagging for follow-up. :eyes:

Emily S: after drain, errors dropped from ~18% -> ~2% over 6m. looks stable.

oncall-opsbot: Notify: status -> mitigated. Monitoring will continue.

Alex R: handing off to follow-up oncall. I'm going offline for rest of rotation. Emily picking follow-up.

Emily S: taking handoff. i'll start RCA notes and a timeline. can someone gather node metrics and the exact rolling window that triggered paging?

Raj P: pulling metrics from prod metrics-store for node-07 and dp-orbiter. will attach graphs to the ticket.

Priya K: for customer comms — they want an exec summary for their CTO plus timeline and planned actions. also asking whether this was tenant isolation issue or noisy neighbors.

Emily S: initial analysis: the issue started with a runaway KV cache growth on model instance replica set for orbiter-prod (tenant-limited set). not a cross-tenant DB noise, but due to a model config mismatch after a recent model-push last week.

Sam T: okay, looks like credit discussion will be required. can we estimate downtime/impact window and affected qps? I'll calculate refund estimate once we have the timeline.

Emily S: drafting quick timeline —
- 3600123420 — small error uptick (ignored)
- 3600123450 — 5xx rate >15% (pager fired)
- 3600123456 — Pager posted to #incidents (this thread)
- 3600123460 — Alex cordoned node-07
- 3600123475 — LB rule applied to avoid node-07 IP
- 3600123490 — runtime kv_cache_max reduced and rollout started
- 3600123540 — errors dropped below 3%
- 3600123600 — mitigated / monitoring stable

Priya K: thanks. i'll draft the external customer note for Orbiter — short, transparent, include timeline + mitigation + next steps + offer of credit pending RCA. i'll post draft for review.

Alex R: ops action items for RCA: gather kernel oom logs from node-07, check model-push change that modified cache config, validate autoscaler behavior and pod eviction latency.

Raj P: infra action items: add LB-level healthcheck to detect node-level OOM earlier; add an alert for kv_cache_max growth beyond threshold; recommend hard cap at infra level for dp dedicated pools.

Emily S: putting a placeholder RCA doc in issues: https://redwood-internal/rca/INC-3600123456 (will flesh out).

Sam T: once RCA ready, i'll prepare an executive briefing for account exec and legal if needed. aim to send customer comm by EOD PST.

Priya K: here's the draft external note (very short):
"
Hi Orbiter team —
We detected elevated errors impacting requests routed to your dedicated pool dp-orbiter between 16:17–16:30 PT. We isolated the affected host, applied mitigations, and reduced error rates to normal levels. We are investigating root cause (likely model runtime cache config after a recent deployment) and will share a detailed RCA and credit estimate by tomorrow. We apologize for the impact and are prioritizing fixes to prevent a recurrence.
"

Emily S: looks good. I suggest adding a line about no data loss and the specific mitigations performed.

Priya K: updated and posted to the account Slack. Orbiter acknowledged and requested the RCA + credit estimate.

oncall-opsbot: INC-3600123456 status updated to: monitoring.

Alex R: great job team. follow-ups: postmortem write-up, infra hard caps, model deploy check in the CI that flags kv_cache changes.

Emily S: i'll own the RCA draft and the CI check, Raj will own infra changes, Priya will own customer comms and Sam the credit estimate.

Sam T: noted. i'll loop in legal for the credit terms.

Priya K: thanks all — i'll schedule the 30min follow-up with Orbiter tomorrow 9am PT.

Alex R: archived notes will be attached to INC ticket. thanks, handing back to follow-up oncall. :thumbsup:
